---
title: "LIQPLAT data quality summary"
date: 2026-08-24
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

The rendered tables contain only domain/field-level counts and logic-check
labels.

```{r}
#| label: data-qc

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
horizon_days <- as.integer(config_get(config, "analysis", "horizon_days"))
result_dir <- ensure_directory(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results")
)
input_paths <- c(
  recruitment = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-recruitment.parquet"),
  cohort_follow_up = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  qol = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-qol.parquet"),
  taooh = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-taooh.parquet"),
  ctdna_samples = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"),
  alterations = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-alterations.parquet")
)
if (any(!file.exists(input_paths))) {
  stop("Run 00-data/02-build-analysis-datasets.qmd first.")
}

qc_rows <- list()
logic_rows <- list()
for (domain in names(input_paths)) {
  data <- arrow::read_parquet(input_paths[[domain]]) |>
    as.data.frame()
  schema <- read_data_schema(
    here::here("data", "schema", paste0(domain, ".yml"))
  )
  columns <- schema_columns(schema)

  for (column_name in intersect(names(columns), names(data))) {
    qc_rows[[length(qc_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      domain = domain,
      column = column_name,
      n_rows = nrow(data),
      n_missing = sum(is.na(data[[column_name]])),
      missing_proportion = if (nrow(data) == 0L) NA_real_ else
        mean(is.na(data[[column_name]])),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  key <- as.character(schema$primary_key)
  n_duplicates <- if (length(key)) sum(duplicated(data[key])) else 0L
  logic_rows[[length(logic_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    domain = domain,
    check = "primary_key_duplicates",
    n_violations = n_duplicates,
    status = if (n_duplicates == 0L) "pass" else "fail",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(input_paths[["cohort_follow_up"]]) |>
  as.data.frame()
endpoint_checks <- c(
  primary_follow_up_outside_horizon = sum(
    is.na(cohort$survival_time_days) |
      cohort$survival_time_days < 0 |
      cohort$survival_time_days > horizon_days
  ),
  unrestricted_follow_up_shorter_than_primary = sum(
    is.na(cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted) |
      cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted < cohort$survival_time_days
  ),
  potential_follow_up_shorter_than_unrestricted = sum(
    is.na(cohort$potential_follow_up_days) |
      cohort$potential_follow_up_days < cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted
  ),
  primary_death_inconsistent_with_unrestricted_endpoint = sum(
    cohort$event_death == 1L & (
      is.na(cohort$status_death_unrestricted) |
        cohort$status_death_unrestricted != 1L |
        cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted != cohort$survival_time_days
    )
  )
)
for (check_name in names(endpoint_checks)) {
  n_violations <- unname(endpoint_checks[[check_name]])
  logic_rows[[length(logic_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    domain = "cohort_follow_up",
    check = check_name,
    n_violations = n_violations,
    status = if (n_violations == 0L) "pass" else "fail",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

qc_summary <- do.call(rbind, qc_rows)
logic_summary <- do.call(rbind, logic_rows)
arrow::write_parquet(
  qc_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "data-qc-summary.parquet")
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  logic_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "data-qc-logic.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: completeness
#| tbl-cap: "Non-identifying completeness summary"
#| echo: false

qc_summary |>
  subset(!column %in% c("id", "sample_id", "alteration_id", "assessment_id")) |>
  transform(missing_proportion = round(missing_proportion, 4)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: logic
#| tbl-cap: "Non-identifying logic-check summary"
#| echo: false

logic_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
